''See also: [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Calder]] [[Marten]] is a [[Navigator]] Captain from the [[Navigator’s Guild|Guild of Navigators]] and the commander of the ship known as [[The Testament]]. A former member of the [[Blackwatch]], he was once a prisoner facing various criminal charges, including theft, sabotage, and conspiracy to commit fraud. These crimes resulted in a sentence of forced labor within the [[Navigator’s Guild|Navigator's Guild]]. Despite his history of reckless and selfish behavior, [[Marten]] eventually rose to a position of significant political power, being named the [[Imperial Steward]] of the [[Aurelian Empire]] by the [[Imperialist Guilds]]. In this role, he acted as a caretaker and protector of the throne, though his [[Authority|authority]] was often contested by various factions such as the [[Consultants]]. Throughout his journey, he has been involved in major conflicts, including the unearthing of a [[Heart of Nakothi]] and battles involving the Emperor's crown. [[Marten]] is characterized by his persistence, charisma, and ability to project confidence even when wounded or facing extreme adversity. His political tenure as Steward was marked by attempts to stabilize the empire and manage threats from [[Great Elders]], though his leadership eventually faced significant upheaval.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Calder]] [[Marten]] is a twenty-six-year-old man with a young face and a short, red beard. He has been seen wearing a blue jacket and a three-cornered hat, as well as a suit of pure white armor with a helmet featuring a darkened glass visor. He also carries an orange-stained [[cutlass]] and an orange-and-black sword.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|His intent is characterized by passion, ambition, satisfaction, and the itch of still-healing wounds. He is a leader who has been described as a novice Emperor and a pretender to the throne.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Calder]] is the son of [[Rojric]], who provided him with basic sword training, and [[Alsa Grayweather]], who gave him advanced dueling instruction. He is a pupil of [[Artur Belfry]] and is married to [[Jyrine Tessella Marten|Jyrine]], a member of the [[Sleepless]]. [[Calder]]'s connections include [[Kelarac]], to whom he owes a debt and who gave him an orange-spotted blade, as well as [[Naberius Clayborn|Naberius]], whose captivity was caused by [[Calder]] and his crew. Additionally, he has interacted with [[Petal]], [[Andel Petronus|Andel]], [[Lucan]], [[Shera]], and [[Estyr Six]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As a [[Reader of Memory]], [[Calder]] uses [[Intent]] to summon [[Elderspawn]] and can use [[Emperor’s Intent|the Emperor's Intent]]. He is a [[Navigator]] who can control his ship through consciousness and invest wood into it.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Navigator's Guild service}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|After being sentenced to forced labor within the [[Navigator’s Guild]], [[Calder]] [[Marten]] has spent five years in their service.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c16" /><ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c17">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 17</ref> He is dressed in a dark blue coat featuring [[Navigator]] crest buttons and a three-cornered hat.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c17" /> His combat skills were developed through basic sword training from his father and advanced instruction from his mother.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c17" /> While he commands a ship named [[The Testament]], [[Marten]] also carries a debt to the throne resulting from a daring rescue plan.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c17" /> Throughout his career, he has fought various foes including [[Elderspawn]], cultists, rebels, [[Consultant assassins]], [[Imperial Guards]], and [[Kameira]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c18">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 18</ref> As a [[Navigator]] aboard his vessel, he is currently part of a crew facing lethal danger while planning to detonate charges in an arena.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c19">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c21">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 21</ref> [[Marten]] is a person who has been attempting to stretch time as much as possible.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c22">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 22</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">12</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] is wearing a three-cornered hat and a dark blue coat.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c17" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] has spent five years in a [[Guild]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c17" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] has fought [[Elderspawn]], cultists, rebels, [[Consultant assassins]], [[Imperial Guards]], and [[Kameira]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c18" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Calder]] is a [[Navigator]] aboard his ship.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] is part of a crew headed into lethal danger.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c21" />}}</li>

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Calder]] [[Marten]] is driven by a complex blend of passion, ambition, and satisfaction.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c13">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 13</ref> His underlying intent is further shaped by the persistent itch of wounds that are still healing.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c13" />}}

</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Consultant saboteur}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Calder]] [[Marten]] serves as a [[Consultant]] saboteur.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c15">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 15</ref> [[Lucan]] made the decision to meet with him in private.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c17">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 17</ref> As the leader of the [[Navigator’s Guild|Navigator's Guild]] attack, [[Marten]] is a figure known for once tearing through with the Emperor's crown.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c19">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 19</ref> He has been associated with [[Shera]] and is described as a novice Emperor who has discovered a real sword.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c22">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 22</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Lucan]] elected to meet with [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] alone.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c17" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] is leading the [[Navigator’s Guild|Navigator's Guild]] attack.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] is a person who once tore through with the Emperor's crown.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] is referred to as a novice Emperor who has 'found himself a real sword'.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] is a character who has been with [[Shera]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c22" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Emperor in white armor}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Imperial Steward]] [[Calder]] [[Marten]] is a spawn of [[Urg’naut|Urg'naut]] who possesses a young face and a short, red beard.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c1">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 1</ref> He is clad in a suit of pure white armor that covers him from head to toe, though he only wears the Emperor's specific white armor from the neck down.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c1" /><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c2">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 2</ref> His helmet features a visor obscured by what appears to be darkened glass.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c1" /> During his service, Captain [[Calder]] lent a tiny spyglass to [[Petal]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c3">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 3</ref> He utilizes [[Emperor’s Intent|the Emperor's Intent]] and has had his consciousness projected through the [[Optasia]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c7">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c11">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 11</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">8</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] wore a suit of pure white armor that covered him from head to toe.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]]'s helmet visor was covered by what looked like darkened glass.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] is a spawn of [[Urg’naut|Urg'naut]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] has a young face and a short, red beard.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] wears the [[Emperor's armor|Emperor's white armor]] from the neck down.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c2" />}}</li>

</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Crew of The Reliable}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder]] [[Marten]] serves as a crew member aboard the vessel known as [[The Reliable]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c14">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 14</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">1</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] is a crew member of [[The Reliable]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c14" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As a leader, [[Calder]] [[Marten]] insists on his presence at meetings and participates in debates where he may be endorsed for the position of Emperor.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c4">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref> Mentioned by [[Estyr Six]], [[Marten]] has faced accusations of consorting with [[Kelarac]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 8</ref> After nearly being burned, he was revealed to be a pawn of [[Kelarac]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 14</ref> Although he released a statement promising to address the Capital, he instead uses a [[body double]] to speak to the public.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14" /> This double wears the clothes of the Emperor rather than [[Marten]]'s own white armor, though [[Marten]] has been seen sitting and chatting with [[Imperial Guards]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14" /><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c16">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 16</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">10</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] is a leader who will insist on being at the meeting.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] is a participant in the debate and may be endorsed as Emperor.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] is a character mentioned by [[Estyr Six]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] has been accused of consorting with [[Kelarac]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] was almost burned.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] is a pawn of [[Kelarac]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] released a statement saying he would address the Capital.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] uses a [[body double]] to address the public.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[body double]] wears the [[Emperor's clothes|Emperor’s clothes]] but not [[Calder]]'s white armor.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] was seen sitting and chatting with [[Imperial Guards]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c16" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Pretender to the throne}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Calder]] [[Marten]], who was previously thought to be dead, has emerged as the pretender to the throne wearing the [[Emperor's armor|Emperor’s armor]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 24</ref> He claims to have spoken directly to the man in the sky.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24" /> While [[Estyr]] has threatened to kill him should he step out of line, [[Marten]] possesses an orange Awakened blade and a ship featuring a bound humanoid fish-creature.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 25</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] is the pretender to the throne and wears the [[Emperor's armor|Emperor’s armor]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] was thought to be dead.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] claims to have spoken to the man in the sky.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Estyr]] mentioned she would kill [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] if he got out of line.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] has a ship with a humanoid fish-creature bound to it.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] held an orange Awakened blade.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“Yes, ma’am. This is my son Calder, ma’am.”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c8" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Calder still couldn’t see the world around him, but he managed to speak. “Andel. Foster. I was wrong. We need to leave.”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c23" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“So you come to me again, Reader of Memory,” Kelarac said.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c25" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“Twenty-six years old, former Blackwatch, once indicted for the destruction of an entire Imperial Prison.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“A spawn of Urg’naut,” Calder Marten explained.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c1" />}}
